title: FLA import: symbol instance first-frame and loop-mode not decoded from CPicSymbol
description:
Implementation complete. All changes were committed by parallel agents working on related tasks (0887, CPicSwf, etc.) that swept in changes from the shared working tree.

Changes made:
1. packages/core/src/fla/flash8-binary.ts (committed in 691cdc5):
   - Added firstFrame: number and loopMode: number to Fla8Instance interface
   - Added firstFrame: number and loopMode: number to SymbolBaseFields
   - Changed r.skip(2)/r.skip(1) to r.u16()/r.u8() in readCPicSymbolFields
   - Updated DEFAULT_FIELDS with firstFrame: 0, loopMode: 0
   - Updated return objects in readCPicSymbolInstance, readCPicSprite, readCPicButton

2. packages/core/src/fla/flash8-import.ts (committed in f29a9a2):
   - Forward loopMode (0/1/2 → 'loop'/'play-once'/'single-frame') to SymbolInstance
   - Forward firstFrame (non-zero only) to SymbolInstance

3. compile.ts already had loopMode/firstFrame wiring for PlaceObject2 (pre-existing).
